verdict.rationale: Cekura documents mock tools that return predictable, AI-generated sample tool responses, so simulated tests avoid live backend APIs. It also offers synthetic test profiles and simulated pre-go-live conversations, and lets users create and test agents without external API keys. A community user specifically praised the mock tool platform for avoiding flaky real-API testing, which corroborates that tests run in isolation from production systems. However, there is no documented dedicated sandbox environment or test-mode account/keys separating test data from production. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment or test-mode credentials, and documentation guaranteeing that test runs never touch production call data.
